english.title: Landlord / licensor with superior interest in residential accommodation required to be licensed under Part 3 of the Act
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 95(1)(b) and (5) of the Housing Act 2004.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
landlord under a tenancy or
licensor under a licence to occupy
with an estate / interest / right in relation to the house
that was superior to the estate / interest / right of a person in section 95(1A)
the house required to be licensed under Pt 3
but was not so licensed

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In proceedings against a person for an offence under section 95(1)(b), it is a defence for a person to prove that they -
did not know, and had a reasonable excuse for not knowing, that the house was one to which this Part applies,
took all reasonably practicable steps to ensure that the house was licensed under this Part, or had some other reasonable excuse for failing to ensure that the house was so licensed. (ii) For an offence committed before the 1st May 2026, see H15310.
